name: Greece (since 1830)
summary: The modern Greek state, independent from the Ottoman Empire in 1830, which grew to its present borders by 1947 and has been a republic since 1974.

knownFor.label: Revival of the Olympic Games
knownFor.note: The first modern Olympics were held in Athens.
